s: Chanda Railway Scheme was proposed in the year?
x:
The Chanda Railway Scheme was proposed in 1880 during the rule of the Nizam of Hyderabad. The proposal generated considerable opposition because many people believed that the project would primarily benefit British commercial interests rather than the people of Hyderabad State. The agitation against the scheme became one of the earliest public movements in Hyderabad.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
